message:
docs(tasks): record the loose port parse at directory_client.cpp:451

Same class as the one fixed for the observe metadata, found while working
nearby and left alone. The UDP observe reply's port goes through the shared
JSON getter, which matches [0-9]+ and so reads 29181 out of 29181.5, and
this site has no upper bound either -- 65537 truncates to 1 on the cast,
with only port == 0 rejected. The value decides whether the host is
reachable, and the comment three lines below already says what a wrong one
looks like: silence that reads as a broken host.

Recorded rather than fixed. It is outside this task, and folding it in
would blur the diff of the one being reviewed.
